<!-- Please read this before spending any more time. -->

## Pull requests are not merged on this project

Thank you for wanting to help - genuinely. This one will be closed, and
that is not a judgment on your code.

FOSSStudio is entirely Lightmorphic's own work, and because Lightmorphic
owns all of it, it can offer the same code under other terms. That is
how the hosted service that pays for this project is possible. A patch
belongs to whoever wrote it, so from the moment one is merged that stops
being true. There is no contributor agreement in place yet, and until
there is, nothing from outside can be taken in.

[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) explains it in full.

## What helps instead

- **Open an issue.** What you did, what you expected, what happened.
  A good bug report is worth more to us than a patch.
- **Open a discussion** for an idea or a question. Plenty of what is in
  the studio arrived that way.
- **Fork it.** The AGPL gives you that right and you do not need
  permission. If you have made it better for your own use, say so in an
  issue and point at your fork - other people may want it too.

If you have already written the code, please do not paste it here.
Describe the problem and how you fixed it in words, and that will be
just as useful to us and keeps your work yours.
